summary.text: David M. Carr represents the 50th District on the New York City Council, which includes the Mid-Island of Staten Island and Southwest Brooklyn, and was first elected in 2021.
His Council biography says he is Minority Leader and leads the Council's Republican Conference.

paragraphs.text: Carr is a lifelong Mid-Island resident who attended the former St. John Villa Academy and Monsignor Farrell High School and earned a B.A. in political science from Georgetown University, according to his Council biography.

It says he volunteered for local congressional campaigns at age 10 and later worked as a constituent services liaison in the U.S. House of Representatives and as chief of staff to then-Assemblyman Joseph Borelli and to former Council Minority Leader Steven Matteo.

He says he has focused on public safety, infrastructure investment, property tax reform and relief for small businesses, and he authored legislation extending property tax exemptions to Cold War veterans and waiving permit fees to repair fire-damaged homes.
He allocated capital funding for projects including Richmond University Medical Center, Staten Island University Hospital, the Staten Island Zoo and the St. George Theatre.
He lives in Grasmere with his husband, Don.
